title: Book Three · Chapter 155: The Former Helper
story:
Two weeks after Ronan sends his twenty-first letter, Leo's reply arrives.

It is Monday in the third holiday week. Leo writes about a family meal and a game with his friends. He asks about Ronan's next learning choice.

Ronan reads the question before he leaves for the workshop that afternoon.

The former helper is sitting near the counter with Mr Sun. He is older than Ronan and carries a worn folder under one arm.

Mr Sun introduces them. The young man has a little time before he goes to see his uncle.

Ronan takes out his questions.

“Is the practice a paid job?”

“Our course practice isn't,” the young man says. “We do office tasks at local businesses. A teacher checks our work.”

“Every day?”

“Two afternoons a week. Lessons take the other class time.”

He opens the folder. There is a short message above a page of numbers. Ronan moves a second chair toward the table.

“I did this one again three times.”

Ronan looks at the crossed-out lines.

“The message?”

“The numbers. My message was very confident. The total was wrong.”

Ronan laughs, and the young man smiles with him.

“Could you get a paid job too?”

“Some students do. That needs a separate agreement with a business. The centre doesn't promise us wages.”

Ronan writes that below his first question. He cannot put unknown pay into a budget.

Then he asks about an ordinary morning. The young man describes a lesson, a written reply, and a partner's questions about it.

“You need to listen,” he says. “Not just speak.”

He shows Ronan a line from his first reply. It answers a question nobody asked.

Mr Sun looks over and laughs quietly.

“You did that here once too.”

“More than once,” the young man says.

Before he leaves, he tells Ronan to ask the centre about the current costs. His own year began earlier, and some figures may change.

Ronan thanks him and puts the questions away.

At home, he reads Leo's letter again. He wants to tell him about the confident wrong total, but first he tries a small number example from his school book.

Mum comes to the table with a finished collar.

“A good talk?”

“A useful one. He showed me his mistakes too.”

Mum smiles and holds the collar against the light. Ronan checks his own total, rubs out one mark, and writes the full answer beneath the sum.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

confident＝有把握的、自信的；budget＝预算；partner＝一同练习或做事的伙伴；wages＝工资。

## 理解问题

1. 课程实践是否自动带工资？另找有薪工作需要什么？
2. Leo第二十一封回复是否已到？旧帮手展示错误，对Ronan了解课程有什么帮助？

## 读句子

**The total was wrong.**

拆开看：The total / was / wrong.

那笔合计／当时算得／不正确。
